what: On open, the frame (panel) appears at .2 scale and a diagonal mask opens halfway from the top-left and bottom-right corners (.5s power1.inOut) until the panel is fully revealed, then it grows to full size at .5s (power2.inOut). At 1s the mask is removed and is-in is added to hand off to the inner scene entrance, and at 2.3s the after children (scroll hint, band banner) drop in from 30% above over 1s

options.open: Seconds for the diagonal mask to open, default .5
options.grow: Seconds to grow to its own size, default .5
options.after: after: when the child enters (sec), default 2.3
options.fx:intro: Event fired when fully open — add the inner entrance class here

from.where: shared.js .jl-frame (red Frame panel — original .frame-box first open, scroll hint · banner at 2.3s)
